title: Squad Phase Tracker
description: Tracks the current implementation phase. Lead PRs updates; Tier-1 lints PR file paths against allowedFolders / warningFolders as a soft warning gate.

$schema.description: Path to this schema file for editor IntelliSense.

currentPhase.description: Current phase number. 0 = Tenant & governance setup; 1 = Data model & seed; 2 = Power Pages Code Site; 3 = Power Apps Code App; 4 = Power Automate flows; 5 = Copilot Studio agents; 6 = Demo script & polish.

currentPhaseName.description: Human-readable phase name. Must match the standard phase name for the currentPhase number.

phaseStartedAt.description: ISO date when this phase started. Used by Tier-1 to detect stale phase.json (warns if phase >30 days old with active commits).

allowedFolders.description: Folders/paths that PRs are expected to touch in this phase. No warning if PR only touches these.

warningFolders.description: Folders/paths that PRs should NOT typically touch in this phase. Tier-1 warns (does not block) if a PR touches one of these. Lead can dismiss the warning by adding a 'phase-cross-cutting' label or by transitioning the phase.

completionChecklist.description: Human-checkable items that must all be done before transitioning to the next phase. Lead's responsibility to track.
